'''Burnin Konn''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. It possessed rich deposits of various [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and was one of the four [[Mining Worlds/Legends|Mining Worlds]] controlled by the [[Figg family]]'s [[Figg conglomerate|corporate interests]]. Burnin Konn's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Plant/Legends|plants]] had all been stripped by the mining operations on the world.

==Description==
Burnin Konn was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GG" /> located in the [[Burnin Konn system/Legends|Burnin Konn system]], a part of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. It was situated in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Hyperspace route/Legends|Hyperlanes]] linked it to the [[Allyuen system/Legends|Allyuen]], [[Ione system/Legends|Ione]], [[Isis system|Isis]], and [[Tokmia system/Legends|Tokmia systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

An [[Ore/Legends|ore]]-rich world, Burnin Konn had deposits of several [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] such as<ref name="GG" /> the [[Metal/Legends|metals]]<ref name="CSWE Nkllon">{{CSWECite|II|385|Nkllon}}</ref> [[Kammris/Legends|kammris]] and<ref name="GG" /> the valuable [[Dolovite/Legends|dolovite]].<ref name="CSWE Dolovite">{{CSWECite|I|196|Dolovite}}</ref> The planet originally featured [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Plant/Legends|flora]], but it was all stripped a long [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="TEA" /> prior to [[43 ABY]],<ref name="43 ABY">The section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' describing Burnin Konn ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> during the ceaseless [[Mining/Legends|mining]] of the world's minerals.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG" /> at some point between approximately [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]].<ref name="GG" /> Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] containing Burnin Konn was re-designated as the Anoat sector.<ref name="GG" /> The planet eventually became one of the four [[Mining Worlds/Legends|Mining Worlds]], all of which were controlled by<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Figg conglomerate|corporate interests]] of the Greater Javin's influential [[Figg family]].<ref name="GG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Burnin Konn was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
